facts.fact: 日期抬头：2024 年 11 月 5 日星期二，Alba 与 Zach 都二十三岁；本章由 Alba 第一人称叙述
Alba 几周前就邮寄投票，为的是选举日不必出门、不必见任何人
facts.anchor: I voted by mail, weeks ago, so I wouldn’t have to go out today, wouldn’t have to see anyone.

facts.fact: 选举结果她只提前告诉过 Celia 一个人
facts.anchor: The only person I told about the outcome in advance was Celia.

facts.fact: Lucinda 刚满十八岁，这是她第一次有投票权的选举，而这一届有第一位主要政党的黑人女性总统候选人
facts.anchor: she’d just turned eighteen, this is the first election she can vote in, the first Black female major party presidential candidate.

facts.fact: 她对 Mama 与 Beck 说要去 Gomez 和 Charisse 家陪 Zach，其实只想一个人待着，是 Zach 的短信把她叫了过去
facts.anchor: Really, I just want to be alone. Zach has other ideas, though.

facts.fact: 她按响门铃，Zach 一开门她就哭了出来，他把她拉进屋抱住
facts.anchor: I ring the doorbell, Zach answers, I burst into tears, he pulls me into the house and embraces me.

facts.fact: 她把清单拿回来，从 Zach 外套口袋摸走打火机，借他的浴袍，赤脚走到厨房把纸在水槽里烧掉
facts.anchor: I take the list from him, filch his lighter from his coat pocket, borrow his bathrobe, pad to the kitchen on my bare feet and burn the paper in the sink.

facts.fact: 天几乎没亮，两人沉默地出门，牵着手穿过公园，走进哀悼中的城市
facts.anchor: We walk across the park, holding hands, into the mourning city, into the relentless future.
